description: Remove your own audio takes (speech, dialogue, music, sound effects) from your Switch library for good; there is no trash for audio. Call it first without confirm: it lists exactly what would be removed and changes nothing. Then, once the person agrees, call again with confirm true. Up to 50 at a time. Only your own takes. Free.

confirm.description: Leave it out first: the answer says exactly what would be removed. Set true only after the person agrees.

name: delete_my_audio
title: Delete Audio Takes
